messages.content: 在遊戲《動物森友會》中，我對在「夏季」收集昆蟲很感興趣。你能幫我找出這段時間有哪些昆蟲嗎？同樣地，在這個遊戲中，我也想知道在「冬季」可以收集哪些魚類。另外，我正在研究遺傳學，我遇到了一個名為「rs53576」的SNP突變。你能告訴我這在「人類」物種中是什麼類型的突變嗎？最後，我還發現了另一個ID為「rs1800497」的SNP突變。你能幫我找出這在「鼠類」物種中是什麼類型的突變嗎？

function.name: mutation_type_find
function.description: Finds the type of a genetic mutation based on its SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

snp_id.description: The ID of the Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) mutation.

species.description: Species in which the SNP occurs, default is 'Homo sapiens' (Humans).

function.name: get_collectables_in_season
function.description: Retrieve a list of collectable items in a specific game during a specified season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

season.description: The season for which to retrieve the collectable items.

item_type.description: The type of item to search for. Default is 'all'. Possible values: 'all', 'bug', 'fish', 'sea creatures', etc.
